header:
You judge the grammaticality of Uzbek sentences.

Below are 150 numbered items. Each item has two Uzbek sentences, labelled 1 and 2. For each item: which of the two sentences is grammatically correct? Exactly one of them is.

Answer from your own knowledge of Uzbek and judge each item on its own. Apart from returning your answers, do not use any tools: do not read or search files, run code or search the web.

Return an answer for every item from 1 to 150, even when you are unsure: the item number and the number (1 or 2) of the grammatically correct sentence.
